root_cause.text: The X.25 receive path in `x25_queue_rx_frame()` accumulated fragment lengths in `x25_sock.fraglen` without any upper-bound check, and `x25_clear_queues()` failed to reset that length after purging `fragment_queue`, allowing `fraglen` to overflow across packet accumulation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (x25->fraglen + skb->len > USHRT_MAX) return 1;` in `net/x25/x25_in.c` to prevent overflow, and adds `x25->fraglen = 0;` after `skb_queue_purge(&x25->fragment_queue);` in `net/x25/x25_subr.c`, confirming the bug was unchecked growth of the `fraglen` accumulator and stale state after queue purge.

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds `if (x25->fraglen + skb->len > USHRT_MAX) return 1;` in `net/x25/x25_in.c` to prevent overflow, and adds `x25->fraglen = 0;` after `skb_queue_purge(&x25->fragment_queue);` in `net/x25/x25_subr.c`, confirming the bug was unchecked growth of the `fraglen` accumulator and stale state after queue purge.

intent_record.intent_summary: Prevent X25 fragment length overflow by rejecting frames that would exceed the maximum unsigned short size.
intent_record.what: Added a guard at the start of x25_queue_rx_frame() that checks whether x25->fraglen + skb->len exceeds USHRT_MAX, and if so returns 1 immediately before any fragment-length update or queueing occurs.
intent_record.how: This prevents the accumulated fragment length from overflowing an unsigned short-sized limit when receiving frames, avoiding wraparound and incorrect fragment accounting during X25 reassembly.

intent_record.intent_summary: Reset the X.25 fragment length when clearing queues to avoid leaving stale fragment state behind.
intent_record.what: In x25_clear_queues(), a new assignment was added after purging the fragment queue: `x25->fraglen = 0;`.
intent_record.how: When the X.25 queues are cleared, the stored fragment length is now reset to zero as well, preventing stale fragment-length state from persisting after queue cleanup.

grouping_result.intent: Prevent X25 fragment length overflow by rejecting frames that would exceed the maximum unsigned short size.
Reset the X.25 fragment length when clearing queues to avoid leaving stale fragment state behind.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the reported X.25 fraglen overflow by adding an upper-bound check to reject frames that would exceed the maximum unsigned short size, which matches the root cause of unchecked fragment length accumulation.

The change directly addresses one part of the root cause: `x25_clear_queues()` not resetting `fraglen` after clearing `fragment_queue`. Resetting the fragment length prevents stale accumulation state from persisting across packets.

candidates.rationale: This statement accumulates fragment length without any upper-bound check, directly causing fraglen to overflow as more fragments are received.
Purging the fragment queue without resetting fraglen leaves stale accumulated length in the socket state, enabling overflow across subsequent packet reassembly.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement adds each received fragment length into x25->fraglen with no upper-bound check, which is the direct overflow source in x25_queue_rx_frame().
This statement clears the fragment queue but does not reset x25->fraglen, leaving stale accumulated length in socket state and allowing overflow across later reassembly attempts.
